method: Read every English/Arabic pair with neighbouring story context; inspected omissions, additions, negation, identity/memory terminology, speaker pronouns, formal register. Corrected narrative paragraphs without moving text across original blank paragraph gaps. Validation separately checks metadata, newline counts, blank positions and ordered control tags.
